title: Add optimized C implementation for `secp256k1` curve (based on code from Pieter Wuille)
body:
This Pull Request adds optimized C code on platforms supporting `uint128_t` type for the elliptic curve `secp256k1`.
It also adds `secp256k1` to the list of benchmarked curves.

The performance improvement is ~10x for ECDSA signature and  and ~4x for verification:
```
Before:
$ ./apps/openssl speed ecdsa
[...]
256 bits ecdsa (secp256k1)   0.0002s   0.0002s   4784.1   5074.3
[...]

After:
$ ./apps/openssl speed ecdsa
[...]
 256 bits ecdsa (secp256k1)   0.0000s   0.0000s  47047.1  21591.0
[...]
```

Fixes #23524
